## Context / Problem
The bounded Agent operation [rebar:kingsize-unfair-blackbird] changes two observable compatibility seams by design: successful retries now expose whole-run usage, and Pydantic wraps retry exhaustion in broad `UnexpectedModelBehavior`. Rebar consumers require one truthful operation row, typed resolution behavior, consumed-so-far diagnostics, and complete final-failure artifacts (`src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py:362-381`, `src/rebar/llm/run_failure.py:48-157`, `src/rebar/llm/usage_log.py:491-642`).

## Approach
Treat the Pydantic Agent run as the accounting unit. Project its aggregate `RunUsage` once through `_extract_usage`, `agent_call`, gate aggregates, and the durable JSONL row; never subtract rejected output attempts or emit per-attempt rows. On exhaustion, walk the standard Python cause chain of the terminating `UnexpectedModelBehavior` (empirically grounded against pydantic-ai 1.107.x in the grounding comment): a VALIDATION-failure exhaustion reaches the identical Rebar `StructuredOutputError` at `UnexpectedModelBehavior.__cause__` -> `ToolRetryError` -> `ModelRetry.__cause__`, because S2's `pai_output.output_function` raises `ModelRetry(str(err)) from err` so that exact object survives on the chain — S3 re-raises THAT identical object, preserving its subtype. A repeated-truncation/concision exhaustion carries NO Rebar object (S2's `concision_guard` raises a bare `ModelRetry(CONCISION_INSTRUCTION)` with no `__cause__`), so the DEFINED chain-absent fallback constructs a fresh `UnretryableOutputError`. Leave an unrelated `UnexpectedModelBehavior` (no 'Exceeded maximum output retries' marker) unchanged. Capture the complete final provider response only at terminal failure through the existing opt-in artifact policy; retry-wire omission never mutates stored messages.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py` — whole-run usage extraction and compatibility result.
- `src/rebar/llm/run_failure.py`, `src/rebar/llm/failure.py` — exact cause-chain restoration and sanitized consumed counters.
- `src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py`, `src/rebar/llm/usage_log.py` — one-row success/failure recording and complete final artifact timing.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sizing.py`, `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py` — verify existing aggregates retain the complete operation counters without a parallel attempt field.
- Focused usage, failure-matrix, hardening, artifact, and plan-review tests.

## Testing
- Successful invalid-then-valid output with attempt usage 5 and 7 reports requests=2 and output_tokens=12 in memory, aggregate telemetry, and one JSONL row.
- Validation and output-size exhaustion restore their exact Rebar objects; an unrelated upstream exception remains untouched.
- Terminal failure preserves consumed requests/tokens and stores only the complete final response when artifact capture is enabled.
- Historical rows and pricing remain compatible because no new core usage field is introduced.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A successful two-attempt Agent run reports the sum of both attempts in `_usage`, Pass-1 aggregate telemetry, and exactly one durable JSONL row; verified by focused usage and plan-review tests.
- [x] Validation exhaustion re-raises the IDENTICAL Rebar `StructuredOutputError` object (same `id()`, found by walking the terminating `UnexpectedModelBehavior` cause chain); a repeated-truncation/output-size exhaustion — whose concision `ModelRetry` carries no Rebar object — surfaces a freshly-constructed `UnretryableOutputError` (the defined chain-absent fallback); and an unrelated `UnexpectedModelBehavior` remains untranslated; verified by identity, chain-absent-fallback, and negative-guard tests.
- [x] Failure diagnostics retain consumed requests, tool calls, and provider-reported tokens without creating a fictional usage value for a call that reported none; verified by the failure-matrix suite.
- [x] When parse-failure artifacts are enabled, only terminal failure writes an artifact and that artifact contains the complete final provider response even when the retry wire omitted an earlier response; verified by artifact-content and file-count tests.
- [x] Existing pricing and usage reports remain byte-compatible apart from the approved higher counters after successful retry; verified by historical-row and pricing fixtures.
- [x] `_usage` and usage JSONL contain no `candidate_requests` or other competing request-budget field; verified by schema assertions.
